policy.history: Quarterly YoY requires same fiscal quarter; annual requires source 350-380-day periods and matching fiscal calendars; TTM requires four contiguous source quarters. Prior values use the visible restatement vintage.
policy.denominators: Actual averages of current/prior source stocks; missing prior is NULL. Zero growth base is NULL; negative base uses abs(base) with explicit negative-base quality flag.
policy.currency: Same economically comparable reporting currency or verified source FX conversion; unsupported currency/basis is NULL.
policy.sector: Existing bank/insurer/REIT structural masks; no observed-missingness structural inference.
policy.coverage: Every year2020-2025 in member_equity, univ_all_common, univ_r3000p; ordinary missing history remains eligible denominator. Measurements pending final producer and coordinated universe snapshot.
policy.returns: All return statistics and complete label windows end before2023-01-01.
